name: recording-mode
description: Hides sensitive details on screen while you record or demo Claude Code; the model still works with the real text

startOn.title: Start with recording mode on
startOn.description: Turn recording mode on whenever a session starts. Otherwise use /recording on.

hideTerms.title: Always hide
hideTerms.description: Words or phrases to hide whenever recording mode is on, such as client names, product names or prices.

maskMoney.title: Hide money amounts
maskMoney.description: Also hide amounts such as $39 or $1.2M.

maskHomePath.title: Hide home folder paths
maskHomePath.description: Show /home/you/project as ~/project, so your username stays off screen.
